notes.title: Update 1.0.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41599148/6073faaa76b1bf15bd85cdf8cacb7624799ab8d6.png[/img]

I'm thrilled to announce the full release of Revenants: Spirit & Mind on the Steam store! It's taken 2 years of development and 9 months of early access to get here. Thank you to the community for all the feedback and testing, and to any content creators who've played Revenants.

During this time we've made some major upgrades. A complete overhaul of the audio has made Revenants more immersive than ever. There's also a new OST developed by Shodah. if you're going to battle demons, you might as well have a killer soundtrack to keep you going. There have also been big changes to the gameplay with a new system for the tablet camera, and the revenant behavior. In the last major update, we changed the lighting to a darker more realistic look. You can be sure that these changes will make a bump in the night. 

What's next for Revenants? There will be some patches in the following weeks to fix any new bugs, the ion-flashbang also has a planned re-work. After this, the main development focus will be to finish changing VR frameworks from SteamVR to OpenXR. This will allow revenants to be released on additional platforms including the Quest. More optimizations will come at a similar time.  Future cases will then be developed based on how well Spirit & Mind is received.


[h1]Latest Changes[/h1]
[b]Update 1.0.0[/b]

[b]New[/b]
[list]
[*] New ambient sounds for the basement and academy roof
[*] New audio for the ritual scene
[*] New interactable objects for the basement, and some in the academy
[*] New evidence sound when a newspaper is discovered
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated Ion-Flashbang blueprint instructions for the current version
[*] Removed some animations from the ritual scene
[*] Increased size of basement files
[*] Reduced volume of footsteps, some ambient sounds, intro and menu music
[*] Changed hidden mask HP to 2
[*] Removed most of the streetlights from the back of the academy
[*] Reverted the main EMC sensor sound
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed light glitches around the academy
[*] Fixed various environment fixes around the academy
[*] Fixed revenant not going for every camera 
[*] Fixed noticeable LOD transitions
[*] Optimized roof performance by removing some academy windows
[*] Fixed saferoom voice line repeating
[*] Optimized models by combining meshes
[*] Fixed revenant not stalking player in certain areas
[*] Fixed the EMC, Tesla Gate, and Flashbang in the Training Simulation
[*] Fixed blueprint lighting in the basement
[*] Fixed loading indicator sound
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.5.0
notes.content:
[u][b]Patch notes for 8th July 2022[/b][/u]
Audio has been the focus for the last couple of months, we've got lots of new audio within the gameplay, and a new Original Sound Track created by 'Shodah'. The case lighting has also been changed to be darker and more realistic, so get your masks ready!

[b]Audio Overhaul[/b]
[list]
[*] New OST music by 'Shodah' for the main menu, basement, investigation, and combat
[*] New EMC sound for when the sensor is active but not detecting anything 
[*] New footsteps that are based on floor type
[*] New haunting sounds
[*] New ambient sounds
[*] New menu sounds
[*] New loading sounds
[*] New playground sounds
[*] New Revenant combat sounds
[*] New room tones for background ambience have been added to each area
[*] Reverberation and echo levels now change based on the current room
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] EMC no longer activates and senses whilst holstered on the belt
[*] EMC max range increased
[*] Case files can now been found on the basement table
[*] Updated lighting for the academy to be darker and more realistic
[*] Reflection probes have been added to the academy for more accurate light reflections
[*] Revenant no longer stalks players on the first evidence discovery
[*] The playground is now interactive and physics-based
[*] Shadows removed from mask lights
[*] Evidence requires pictures to be taken within a close distance to be collected
[*] Credits updated to include 'Shodah' for creating the original soundtrack and Elias Hofmann for sound design
[*] Various audio balances
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed loading cube obscuring the menu interface
[*] Fixed subtitles for memorial
[*] Fixed memorial cue repeating 
[*] Fixed EMC sensor rate to be more consistent
[*] Fixed pool balls not grabbing instantly
[*] Fixed tech not working or attaching to walls in the simulation
[*] Fixed masks not saving correctly
[*] Fixed mask health resetting on scene loads
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.4.0
notes.content:
[u][b]Patch Notes for 2nd March 2022[/b][/u]
Expect a massive performance increase! There's also more guidance for the investigation through the Files app. Lilith has also been reworked and rebalanced to be more challenging.

[b]Lilith[/b]
[list]
[*] Lilith will now phase attack the player by rapidly teleporting around them to close the distance and then attack
[*] New animations and visual effects for Lilith
[*] Lilith's movement speed increased from 4 to 5
[*] Emily's movement speed decreased from 4 to 3
[*] More spawn points have been added to corridors and arenas
[*] Lilith fire effect will only start once combat has
[/list]

[b]Files App[/b]
[list]
[*] Case information added to files app Research Folder, giving further guidance for where to go in the investigation
[*] Photos of discovered evidence are stored in the Evidence Folder
[/list]

[*] Revenant health bar stays active whilst crit window is active

[*] Fixed Revenant freezing after being defeated via tesla gate
[*] Fixed Revenant audio not playing

notes.title: Update 0.3.0 'The Basement'
notes.content:
[u][b]Patch Notes for 02/01/2022[/b][/u]
This is a huge Early Access Release update for Revenants with the full core of the game in place! We'll now be focusing on fixing bugs reported by you, as well as general polish and optimisation. The next bug fixing patch will be live by this Friday.

[b]The Basement[/b]

[list]
[*] The Home Basement allows players to return from the case to select different technology, replenish their health and analyse found evidence
[*] Added a hand-held evidence analyser to the Basement for scanning evidence into the case board
[*] The case board is used to put the pieces of the case together to solve it
[*] You'll need to select which 3 types of tech you want to use before travelling to a case as there's now 4 with the addition of the Ion Flashbang!
[*] A VR device can be used in the basement to enter a training simulation
[*] Captured Revenants, collected evidence and newspapers will stay in the basement
[/list]

[b]Other Features[/b]

[list]
[*] The Ion Flashbang is the first weapon tech in Revenants. Thrown directly at a Revenant to stun and slow them
[*]  Profiles are now chosen on the games start, allowing for three sets of save files and progress
[*] There's now a score system for each case run. Using technology to battle the Revenant, trick-shots, discovering newspapers and evidence will all increase your score for the run. Your high score will be saved on the case board
[*] Two cutscenes have been added to Case: Spirit & Mind
[*] The tutorials expanded with a combat and tech section within the simulation
[*] Added music to the main menu
[*] Added audio to mask equip and functionality toggle
[*] Added Tablet Grip Toggle mode
[*] Added Vignette setting
[*] Added new voice lines
[*] Added credits sequence
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Newspapers are collected and sent to the basement once picked up
[*] Balanced audio levels
[*] Teslas now have activation sound
[*] Moved tutorial from Case to Basement
[*] Added guttering, cobwebs and more graffiti to the Academy
[*] Added navigational signs around the Academy
[*] Various art optimisation
[*] All settings now get saved
[*] Re-worked the map app to be more accurate for player and tech positions
[*] Re-worked various voice lines
[*] Added camera flash when taking a photo without UV mode
[*] Added new VFX for mask crack and glass
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Each profile now has its own set of gallery images
[*] Fixed evidence audio not playing
[*] Fixed hands glitching through doors
[*] Various saving fixes, save files before 0.3.0 will no longer work 
[*] Various tutorial fixes
[*] Fixed revenant not spawning
[*] Fixed EMC responsiveness
[*] Fixed pause issues
[*] Narrowed save file size by 80%
[/list]
